children: was added as a new long idea at Hedgeye with potential for 40% upside in the next 9-12 months. Hedgeye is moving Roblox from a short idea to a top long.

"We have been saying that 2026 would be a year of deceleration because the business had to lap the 2025 viral content cycle, when a discovery algorithm that began rewarding time spent inside an experience set off a run of hits and engagement and spend peaked over the summer," Hedgeye analyst Andrew Freedman wrote in a note on Thursday.

But "we now think 3Q26, reported at the end of October, marks the trough," Freedman added. "The comparisons ease from here, a new viral hit has the engagement data turning and 2027 estimates have been reset."

title: Roblox added as a new long idea at Hedgeye
